R110.note: Thorough, version-appropriate crypto/rand fix (rand.Text() / crypto/rand.Read fallback); behavior preserved aside from the token format itself, which is the point of the fix.

(Compare the correct fix in the sibling JSON-bound case.) No other behavior changes, hence no_harm is unaffected.
